name: Alaska
notes: Alaska supports digital ID through the Alaska Mobile ID app. Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: Alaska Mobile ID
steps: Download the Alaska Mobile ID app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Alaska DMV account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Alaska driver's license or ID.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved by the Alaska DMV.
